hypothesis: Using the existing executable source-preserving Q4_K Gravity representation with device-resident F16 KV images and flash attention will reduce decode bytes and complete-token wall time on the same M3 Ultra without changing token decisions.
mechanism: Set HAWKING_GRAVITY_F16_KV=1. GravityLlamaGpu retains the source-preserving packed weights, appends each RoPE'd K/V row into persistent F16 cache images, and selects the F16-KV flash-attention grammar. No weight, tokenizer, prompt, sampling, or command-topology changes are admitted.
scope: same exact source and executable Gravity artifact, same immutable revision, same device, same prompt and complete-token protocol

promotion_gates.rung_claim_requires: candidate median TPS clears TG20 or a higher named rung; otherwise retain the prior TG32 narrow floor

reopen_condition: If F16 KV changes a token, fails source parity, regresses complete-token wall or tail, or cannot prove physical flash dispatches, retire this representation and require a materially different executable representation.
